propositions: BindingStore.unbind() conditionally removes reverse index entries only when the forward entry contains a jira_key, leaving orphaned reverse bindings if the forward entry lacks or loses that key
Reverse entries orphaned by unbind() cannot be cleaned up through the public API, requiring out-of-band access to internal _data to repair
Forward entries removed by routes other than unbind() or _retire() (such as concurrent merge conflicts under merge=ours strategy) leak corresponding reverse keys permanently
The fix makes unbind() sweep the reverse index for residual keys pointing to the deleted local_id after the fast-path keyed pop, ensuring correctness independent of forward entry contents
A new rebar bridge fsck --repair flag with four guards pre-validates store integrity before deletion, ensuring only reverse_missing_forward orphans are removed and no bindings drift occurs
